title: Chart of Accounts only displays Tree View

posts.name: volkswagner
posts.cooked:
I have tried updating and issue still exists. When I choose “list view” in the elipse menu, it still displays the tree view.

I’ve tried:

bench update
bench build
--site migrate
--site clear-cache

I’ve tried multiple browsers and multiple user accounts, and tried manually entering /app/account/view/list in the address bar.

I don’t have any other sites on this server so I can’t compare. I can try creating a new site, but I’d like to hear from folks here first.

I’m looking for help on how to troubleshoot.

ERPNext: v15.79.2 (version-15)
ERPUSA: v0.0.8 (stripe-plus)
Frappe Framework: v15.82.1 (version-15)
Frappe HR: v15.50.0 (version-15)
Payments: v0.0.1 (version-15)
Raven: v2.6.2 (develop)
Wiki: v2.0.0 (master)

posts.name: Ahsan Tareen
posts.cooked:
Hi @volkswagner

Looks like account doctype view setting in customization form has been set to tree view.

posts.name: volkswagner
posts.cooked:
Thank you @ahsantareen. I don’t remember making that adjustment, but I’m sure I did. I’ve been regularly frustrated when viewing in tree mode, then editing account, when returning to the list, the view would reset to list view.

I rarely use List View, so it’s probably been some months since I made the change. There is also another setting that was probably the culprit force_re_route_to_default_view. I also had this checked along with setting the default view to Tree.

Thanks again!
